---
title: "Prices"
---

Every cost in the book is computed from `data/prices.toml`. This appendix shows the prices in it.
All are USD list prices, checked on {{< var prices.as_of >}} against the vendor's own pricing page or
published price data. Each entry in the file records its source URL. Entries that could not be
confirmed are marked unverified in the file, and the cost generator refuses to use them.

List prices are a ceiling. Committed-use discounts, enterprise agreements and startup credits can
cut them substantially, and the same GPU costs very different amounts on different clouds.

## Refreshing the prices

1. Edit `data/prices.toml`: change the value, the `checked` date and, if it moved, the `source`.
2. Run `make costs`. Every table and inline figure is regenerated.
3. Run `make check` to confirm nothing is stale, then commit the data file and the generated
   output together.
